resources.string: Switch on Sleep under Settings > Addons first
Put the phone on the bed, on charge, and press Start when you lie down.
Under 20 minutes, so it was not kept as a night.
Starts your last ambience mix with the session.
Starts your last ambience mix with the session, fading out after %1$d min.
Your first night shows up here in the morning.
Measured with the phone\'s motion sensor
From bed and wake times only
Saved when the app was closed in the night
Estimated: a phone on the bed can tell asleep from awake, but only guesses REM, light and deep from the shape of the night.
The last nights show here once you have recorded one.
Record a few nights and what they say shows up here, with tips that use your Ambience sounds.
You averaged %1$s asleep over the last %2$d nights (goal %3$s).
Sleep debt this week: %1$s below your goal. One longer night or an earlier bedtime pays part of it back.
Best night this week scored %1$d (%2$s), the lowest %3$d.
Nights with Ambience sounds scored %1$d points higher (%2$d nights with them).
Nights with Ambience sounds scored %1$d points lower (%2$d nights with them). Try a lower volume or another sound.
Ambience sounds make no clear difference yet (%1$d nights with them, %2$d without).
%1$s goes with your best nights: %2$d points above your average.
It takes about %1$d minutes to fall asleep, even with sounds on. Try a calmer sound, a dimmer screen before bed, and a fixed wind-down time.
It takes about %1$d minutes to fall asleep. Try the Ambience tab: rain or ocean with a 30 minute timer, started together with the session.
You woke up three or more times a night on average. A cooler, darker, quieter room helps, and so does leaving caffeine out of the afternoon.
Your room was loud on most nights. A steady Ambience sound can cover sudden noises.
Your bed and wake times vary by about %1$d minutes. A fixed time, even on weekends, is one of the best things for sleep.
You are sleeping less than your goal. Try going to bed around %1$s.
Nothing to fix: your sleep looks steady. Keep your times.
Goal, score, recording and the link to Ambience
What a good night is for you, how the score is made and how the night is recorded.
Put every sleep setting back to how it was? The recorded nights stay.
A made-up night: 6 h 40 m asleep, 25 minutes to fall asleep, 2 awakenings, a bedtime 40 minutes off.
How long you want to sleep
What regular times are measured against until there are a few nights
How much it counts, against the other three
Times only is the lightest. Movement uses the motion sensor. Movement and sound also measures how loud the room is; the sound itself is never stored.
How easily movement counts as being awake. Higher if you sleep lightly, lower if a partner moves the bed.
In case you forget to stop it in the morning
Start my ambience mix with the session
Needs the Ambience addon. Brings back the last mix you used.
The sounds fade away by themselves while the recording goes on
Stop the sounds when I stop
When you end the session in the morning
The ring fills in, the stages and bars draw themselves
Removes the history, not the settings
Every recorded night is deleted. This cannot be undone.
Your bedtime is in %1$d minutes (%2$s). Tap Start sleep when you lie down.
It is your bedtime (%1$s). Tap Start sleep when you lie down.
A notification before your usual bedtime, with a Start sleep button. Needs notifications allowed for the app.
How long before your usual bedtime
Battery: %1$d mA on average, %2$d%% used (%3$s%% an hour)
Battery: %1$d mA on average while it was not charging
Recording costs about %1$s%% of the battery an hour (%2$d mA), measured over %3$d nights on battery power.
Recording is heavy on your battery. Charge the phone overnight, or switch to Movement without sound, or to Times only, in the Sleep settings.
